title: HelperSessionConfirmRowsParams
description: Params of the helper session service's confirm-rows op: advance the session's confirmed-written mark, the one mark the helper keeps of what the coordinator holds (nocx-2v80t.3.6). It is the acknowledgement half of the streamed block output: the helper streams rows the moment they leave the screen and keeps no copy, so the mark — not a queue — is what a later resend reads the scrollback against. Keyed by subscriber and session like every reader-keyed op. The op has no result shape rather than an invented one; the answer to "did the mark land" is the absence of an error.

upToRow.description: The absolute row index through which the coordinator has written every streamed row and end marker it received — one PAST the last confirmed row, the same exclusive spelling the end marker's EndRow uses. A mark ahead of what the session ever departed is refused by name: confirming rows that were never sent would make the next resend skip output nobody holds.
